scenarios.name: Show and hide extended feature names in the browser

scenario_steps.name: a part with a 20 mm new-solid extrusion is active in the MCAD Software
Show Extended Names is unchecked in browser Display Preferences
the extrusion is displayed with its short feature name
the user selects Show Extended Names
the extrusion's browser label includes its new-solid operation and 20 mm depth
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user reopens browser Display Preferences
the user selects Show Extended Names again
the extrusion is displayed with its short feature name
the solid remains visible in the viewport
